name: DNONCE
recent: D'nonce Technology 于2026年9月29日举行第26届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括批准董事薪酬、重选两名董事及授权董事会委任新核数师。公司截至2026年6月30日季度营收为5454万令吉，净利242万令吉，营收环比增长5.9%、同比增长12.7%。近期公告亦显示大股东 Erdasan Group Berhad 的持股有变动。
notable: 第26届常年股东大会于2026年9月29日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
股东批准授权董事会为公司委任新核数师。
大股东 Erdasan Group Berhad 于2026年9月24日及28日申报持股变动。
risks: 公司正在更换核数师，股东已授权董事会委任新核数师。
大股东 Erdasan Group Berhad 近期出现持股变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收5454万令吉，净利242万令吉，净利率4.4%；营收环比增长5.9%、同比增长12.7%，上一季度净利率为-17.9%。

recent_en: D'nonce Technology held its 26th AGM on 29 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including approval of directors' fees, re-election of two directors and authorisation for the Board to appoint new auditors. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR54.54 million with net profit of MYR2.42 million, up 5.9% QoQ and 12.7% YoY. Recent filings also show changes in the shareholding of substantial shareholder Erdasan Group Berhad.
notable_en: The 26th AGM was held on 29 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Shareholders approved authorising the Board to appoint new auditors for the Company.
Substantial shareholder Erdasan Group Berhad reported changes in its shareholding on 24 and 28 September 2026.
risks_en: The Company is changing its auditors, with shareholders authorising the Board to appoint new auditors.
Substantial shareholder Erdasan Group Berhad has had recent changes in its shareholding.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR54.54 million and net profit was MYR2.42 million, a net margin of 4.4%; revenue rose 5.9% QoQ and 12.7% YoY, versus a net margin of -17.9% in the prior quarter.
